scope.coverageClaim: Regional candidates for viewport selection, not proof of full Kansas native coverage or locally installed rasters.

notes: The public EPT bucket is free/no-account; the different usgs-lidar original bucket is requester-pays and excluded.
Prefix listing alone is not metadata/data availability: unindexed prefixes with ept.json404 are not admitted as usable projects.
Every catalog record has a freshly fetched valid ept.json with EPSG3857 metadata.
All127 candidates include native Classification; this does not establish which class values exist.
Source LAS header decoding must preserve withheld/synthetic/overlap flags even where ClassFlags is absent from EPT schema.
Do not merge surveys/dates blindly or infer field accuracy from encoding scale.
Footprint index geometry is provider-maintainer discovery context, not surveyed legal coverage; preserve sparse holes/NoData.
Project KS_Statewide_2017 is only a north-central regional footprint; never treat its name as statewide coverage.
One unindexed WA prefix still had connection-reset metadata failure; unlocated/404 prefixes are recorded in receipts, not claimed as spatially ruled out.
